liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turmoil and Tinfoil** (3 other sources): The song includes teases of Norwegian Wood; Norwegian Wood is teased within this song [1][3][5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Willie Roy**: rare: 5 archived performances [7]
- **Blue Mule**: rare: 14 archived performances [7]
- **Southbound**: rare: 8 archived performances [7]
- **Dealing Dispair**: rare: 8 archived performances [7]
- **Norwegian Wood**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk41_mk4.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 124 min [1]
- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk41.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 124 min [3]
- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk4.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 124 min [5]
- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk41_mk4.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 124 min [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk41_mk4.flac24**: taped by Jesse Mc; transferred by Jesse Mc; source: Schoeps MK41(dina) > KC5 > CMC6 > Lunatec V3 + Schoeps MK4(ortf) > KC5 > CMC6 > Lunatec V3 > Tascam DR-680(24/48) [1]. Also: Jesse Mc taped and seeded it; mixed in Samplitude with level and EQ adjustments, then Sound Forge, CD Wave and TLH [1]
- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk41.flac24**: taped by Jesse Mc; transferred by Jesse Mc; source: Schoeps MK41(dina) > KC5 > CMC6 > Lunatec V3 > Tascam DR-680(24/48) [3]. Also: Jesse Mc taped, tracked and seeded it; transferred via Sound Forge, CD Wave and FLAC Frontend [3]
- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk4.flac24**: taped by Jesse Mc; transferred by Jesse Mc; source: Schoeps MK4(ortf) > KC5 > CMC6 > Lunatec V3 > Tascam DR-680(24/48) [5]. Also: Jesse Mc taped, tracked and seeded it; transferred via Sound Forge, CD Wave and FLAC Frontend [5]
- **billystrings2020-01-25.mk41_mk4.flac16**: taped by Jesse Mc; transferred by Jesse Mc; source: Schoeps MK41(dina) > KC5 > CMC6 > Lunatec V3 + Schoeps MK4(ortf) > KC5 > CMC6 > Lunatec V3 > Tascam DR-680(24/48) [2]
